facebook.caption: Tourists keep walking past this. Hung Quoc Tu Pagoda sits on Nguyễn Trung Trực and most visitors never stop. 4.5 stars. 71 reviews. Almost zero foot traffic from foreigners. Red lanterns, incense smoke, complete silence on a weekday morning. This is Phu Quoc without the crowds. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Incense rising. Lanterns swaying. Zero other tourists in sight. Hung Quoc Tu Pagoda is the Phu Quoc stop nobody talks about. 4.5 stars and you'll have it to yourself.
